name: biela.dev
tagline: Biela.dev is an AI app builder that generates a fully functional web application from a plain-language description, with no coding knowledge required. Non-technical founders and product managers use it to go from idea to a working product they can actually test with users, without waiting for a developer. It handles the full stack from frontend to database, focusing on getting something live quickly rather than giving users granular control over every architectural choice.
